title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
why_read: A clever unsupervised benchmark for checking whether pathology AI models actually learn real biology, not just task performance, which matters for trust in medical AI.
analysis: Pathology foundation models, which learn general-purpose representations from microscope tissue images, are usually judged only by how well they do on downstream classification tasks. This paper introduces BioScore, which instead checks whether a model's internal features actually correspond to real cell types, using spatial gene-expression data from the same tissue as ground truth. Without needing labels, their method consistently ranks pathology-specific models above generic image models and separates meaningful performance tiers. This gives practitioners a biologically grounded way to evaluate whether these models' representations reflect real biology rather than being black boxes.
